datasets.name: LoanAccs
datasets.sql:
SELECT   ac.id AS id, ac.kli_id AS custid, ac.acc_no AS accno,
         ac.NAME AS clientname, ac.val_acc
    FROM account ac
   WHERE
   close_dat is null and ac.kli_id=:kli_id  AND val_acc = :val_acc AND

   (ac.bal_cn1 IN (SELECT accountnumber
                           FROM cm_aginfo
                          WHERE groupid = (SELECT g.id
                                             FROM cm_accountgroups g
                                            WHERE g.iname = 'LoanAccs'))
         )
ORDER BY accno,kli_id

datasets.name: DepozitDSet
datasets.sql:
select (select tipacc from account where id=acc.contractaccid) arest,
       cont.id,cont.creditstatus,
       cont.contractno,
       sbcm_stored_programs.Get_ContractAccount(acc.contractaccid) as ContractAccNO,
       av.val_name,
       sbcm_stored_programs.Get_ContractAccountName(acc.contractaccid) as CustomerName,
       cstate.facticaldebt*tmp.ostat as ekfacticaldebt,
       cstate.facticalinterestdebt*tmp.ostat as ekfacticalinterestdebt,
       intr.interest,
       cont.opendate,cont.CREDITSTATUS,
       cont.closedate,
      (select name from filial where id=cont.branchid)as Filial

from sbcm_contracts cont,
     sbcm_contract_accounts acc,
     sbcm_interests intr,
     sbcm_contract_state cstate,
     avalute av,
     temprate tmp
where acc.id# = cont.id and
      intr.id# = cont.id and
      cstate.id# = cont.id and
      cont.currency = av.valute and
      cont.currency = tmp.val_kod and 
      cont.type# = 3
